risk_event_and_root_cause: Customers exploit 'Instant Doorstep Refund' by handing over used/counterfeit items or empty boxes to hurried couriers.
mitigation_and_prevention_strategy: Enforce BR-06 (<=₹5,000 & Return Rate <35% only) + BR-08 mandatory 4-point mobile QC with barcode scan & tag photo.
contingency_fallback_plan: Auto-block Green Channel for any account with 1 failed FC C-Returns audit; debit ATS Delivery Station / Associate for unverified scans.

risk_event_and_root_cause: 4-Point Doorstep QC increases courier stop time, causing daily delivery/pickup route delays.
mitigation_and_prevention_strategy: Streamlined mobile UI to 4 binary taps + 1 barcode scan (benchmarked at 65 seconds per stop in pilot).
contingency_fallback_plan: Disable doorstep photo step during peak Great Indian Festival (GIF) sale days for trusted Tier-1 accounts.

risk_event_and_root_cause: Customers game 'Buy X Get Y' or minimum-cart coupons by returning high-margin items and keeping discounted items.
mitigation_and_prevention_strategy: Implement BR-05 deterministic Pro-Rata Coupon Recalculation engine shown upfront prior to return confirmation.
contingency_fallback_plan: Waive promo clawback if customer chooses Store Exchange or Amazon Pay Balance credit.

risk_event_and_root_cause: NPCI UPI or IMPS banking network downtime causes Instant Refund or Penny-Drop timeouts.
mitigation_and_prevention_strategy: Asynchronous retry queue with exponential backoff (every 15m for 4 hours) + multi-gateway routing (Amazon Pay UPI + NPCI / Axis-Yes Bank Payout Rails).
contingency_fallback_plan: Send automated SMS offering 1-click switch to Instant Amazon Pay Balance (+5% bonus) if bank rails are down.

risk_event_and_root_cause: Legitimate customer's return is wrongly rejected at doorstep by an untrained courier agent.
mitigation_and_prevention_strategy: Require courier to capture clear photo of alleged defect/missing tag before the app allows 'QC Fail' submission.
contingency_fallback_plan: Customer receives instant 'Contest Rejection' button in app -> Priority L2 Support review within 4 hours.

risk_event_and_root_cause: Customers systematically order <₹299 items and claim damage to get free 'Returnless Refunds'.
mitigation_and_prevention_strategy: Enforce BR-09 hard cap of max 1 Returnless Refund per customer/device/address per 365 days + mandatory live camera photo.
contingency_fallback_plan: Route any 2nd claim on <₹299 items to standard physical pickup.
